The 8th and 9th grade optional home economics groups did a project with Vaasan Oy featuring their new product “The Wrap”. The students created their own recipes and had great fun doing it. Vaasan Oy wrote an article about the cooperation in their Street Beats magazine, which we shared earlier. You can read the article here, from pages 24-27. Vaasan also created a video about the project, which you can check out here!
